verdict.rationale: The tool-logs docs describe a raw execution log for every tool call the platform observes, covering hosted, tunneled, and shadow MCP servers, skills, and local tools, with trace expansion and attribute filters. Product pages add an audit log on every tool call, recorded in one exportable record tied to a named employee. Missing for 10: no evidence that logs capture full request/response payloads or support replaying an agent's actions, and no independent or hands-on corroboration of the logging.
